name: MOT_TERR_DIM_PARTITIONS
description: Partitions divide the TM space between production and stage environments. Partition entity is the reference entity for many Territory Management entities, which defines which partition their records belong to. Additionally Partition entity holds information on areas such as cube name (for a given partition), the partition status etc.

columns.name: TERR_DIM_PARTITION_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: TERRITORY_VALIDATION_FLAG
columns.description: Enable territories validations and load dimension members for optionally synchronized dimensions.

columns.name: CUBE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the cube.

columns.name: ESSBASE_APPS_NAME
columns.description: Name of the application in ESSBASE.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code of the partition

columns.name: TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the partition.

columns.name: ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: Stores error message in case of failure in synchronization process.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the updating process.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Holds the Load Status Code

columns.name: UPLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Load process.

columns.name: LAST_UPLOAD_START_DATE
columns.description: Time of the last started upload of the dimensions belonging to the partition

columns.name: LAST_UPLOAD_END_DATE
columns.description: Time of the last completed upload of the dimensions belonging to the partition

columns.name: ACTIVATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Activation process.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Holds the Activation Status Code

columns.name: ACTIVATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Activation start date,i.e date when the activation was started

columns.name: ACTIVATION_END_DATE
columns.description: Activation end date,i.e date when the activation was completed

columns.name: LAST_OPERATION
columns.description: Name of last ESS operation performed, or null if no operation has been performed on a partition.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_CONTEXT
columns.description: Stores the context of the ESS request.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: ASGN_PRECEDENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Enable assignment precedence using inclusion

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
